title: Hard to use
text: Hard to use. I am disappointed in this can opener.  It is supposed to be very easy for older folks to use.  Well, it isn't!  I have been trying to learn to use it properly but continue to have problems. The lid of the can doesn't get cut all the way through.  The opener seems to be very stiff, so I have trouble trying to position it correctly on the can I am trying to open.  It was not a good investment for me!
